name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's career began far from the roar of engines, in the Serbian military police. His meticulous approach to security, honed through years of service, caught the eye of a local racing team owner looking to upgrade his team's security protocols. He transitioned into motorsport nearly two decades ago, starting with smaller rally teams before making his way up to Formula categories.

He's known for his unflappable demeanor and his ability to anticipate potential security breaches before they occur. Nikola values a proactive approach, emphasizing thorough background checks, robust access control systems, and constant vigilance. He believes a secure environment is crucial for any team to perform at its best, allowing drivers and engineers to focus solely on the race.

What sets Nikola apart is his blend of military precision with a genuine passion for motorsport. He understands the unique pressures and vulnerabilities of the sport, and his commitment to ensuring the safety and integrity of his team is unwavering. He's seen it all, from petty theft to industrial espionage, and he's always one step ahead.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Nikola is a powerfully built man with a stern face and a commanding presence.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with security protocols.
Insists on using military time for all team communications.
Has a habit of polishing his security badge obsessively.
